what: The bridge is the one place that says where every copy of the novel is, which copy is the book right now, and how a chat changes the manuscript without breaking it. Any chat, on any surface, starts here.
editing: Check the workboard before you start (manuscript/novel/WORKBOARD.md, or the block "Who is working on what" at the top of the v4 scaffold), and claim your task there. Two sessions started the same job on 22 November without knowing.
Find the current manuscript. Exactly one copy in the map is marked CURRENT. Edit that one and no other.
Read it fresh, right before the edit. The author and other chats type in it while you work, so a read from ten minutes ago is out of date.
Make the change as a suggestion, so the author can accept or reject it. Make a direct edit only when he has said so, in so many words, in this conversation.
Change words by exact match, never by position. Pick a short plain passage that appears exactly once in the whole Doc, and replace it.
Keep the match short. A suggestion deletes the matched words and types them again, which drops italics and links on them.
Read the Doc again. Confirm your suggestion is there and that nothing else moved.
Tell the author what you changed in a few plain lines, with the chapter.
If the change settles a fact (a name, a distance, who knows what), write it in that character's notes file and under "Decided so far" in the v4 scaffold.
If you make a new copy or a new version, add it to the map: instances.json in the repository, and the bridge page in Google Drive.
rules: No em dashes or en dashes anywhere in the book or in notes about it.
When the author dictates lines, use his words. Fix typos and change nothing else.
The 19 pictures stay in the manuscript. Do not remove them.
The book never says who Bidwell's watcher is. No edit may clear anyone of being that person.
The author's personal journal material stays out of every file.
Pushing to main on GitHub redeploys the live site. Do it only when he says.
Reply to the author in a few short plain lines. Lead with what happened.
withCode: node scripts/sts-bridge.mjs status              every copy, and which one is the book right now
node scripts/sts-bridge.mjs check               is the map sound
node scripts/sts-bridge.mjs where <name>        an entry, a chapter (chapter-9), or a copy (site-reader)
node scripts/sts-bridge.mjs edit READ.json --find "old words" --replace "new words"     checks the change and prints the request to send
node scripts/sts-bridge.mjs suggestions READ.json     the suggestions waiting in the Doc, by chapter
node scripts/sts-bridge.mjs verify READ.json --replace "new words"     after sending: is it there
withoutCode: Open the bridge page in Google Drive (search Drive for "sts-bridge"). It lists every copy with a link and marks the current one.
Read the current manuscript with the Docs connector.
Count how many times your passage appears. If it is not exactly once, lengthen it until it is.
Send one replaceAllText request with writeControl.writeMode set to SUGGEST and matchCase true.
Read the Doc again and find your suggestion.

code.note: Merged to main on 22 November 2026. Pushing to main redeploys the live site, so code changes there wait on the author; notes such as WORKBOARD.md are fine.
